## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
metadata_view <- read.csv("Data/Nov_2024/oculina_nov2024_isotopes.csv")
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

Ella's preliminary boxplots:

```{r}
library(SIBER)
library(tidyverse)
#library(rjags)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
#help(SIBER)

#nov 2024 data

iso_nov24<-read.csv("Data/Nov_2024/oculina_nov2024_isotopes.csv")
iso_nov24 <- iso_nov24 %>%
  filter(sample_id !="A5-A-1124-Algae", sample_id !="S11-S-new-1124-Algae") %>% #remove sample IDs that are not paired algae & host
  filter(algae_host != "Filter") #remove filter samples for now
```

```{r}
iso_nov24_host <- read.csv("Data/Nov_2024/oculina_nov2024_isotopes_host.csv")
iso_nov24_host <- iso_nov24_host %>%
  select(-sample_id,-algae_host,-weight_mg,-total_C_ug,-pct_C,-pct_N,-total_N_ug)
iso_nov24_algae<-read.csv("Data/Nov_2024/oculina_nov2024_isotopes_algae.csv")
iso_nov24_algae <- iso_nov24_algae %>%
  select(-sample_id,-algae_host,-weight_mg,-total_C_ug,-pct_C,-pct_N,-total_N_ug)
iso_nov24_holo <- iso_nov24_algae %>%
  left_join(iso_nov24_host) %>%
  mutate(d15N_holo = d15N_host - d15N_algae,
         d13C_holo = d13C_host - d13C_algae)

```

```{r}
iso_d13C_depth_sa <- ggplot(iso_nov24, aes(x = algae_host, y=d13C, fill = algae_host))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.8, width=0.2)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 22)+
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = expression(paste(delta^{13}, "C (‰, V-PDB)")))+
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~depth_sa)
iso_d13C_depth_sa
```

```{r}
iso_d15N_depth_sa <- ggplot(iso_nov24, aes(x = algae_host, y=d15N, fill = algae_host))+

  geom_jitter(alpha=0.8, width=0.2)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 22)+
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = expression(paste(delta^{15}, "N (‰, air)")))+

iso_d15N_depth_sa
```

merging host samples with metabolomic matrix

```{r}


iso_sum_diff <- read.csv("Data/Nov_2024/priya_sum_diff_ocu_nov24_isotopes.csv")

iso_sum_diff <- iso_sum_diff |>
  mutate(sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, "-1124-Algae"))

oculina_mod <- oculina_final[-c(40:44),] |>
  mutate(sample_id = str_remove(full_id, "-1124"))

oculina_mod <- oculina_mod[, -c(4:11, 13:25, 29:39)] |>
  mutate(sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, "_1124"))


```

```{r}

oculina_mod <- oculina_mod |>
  mutate(sample_id = replace(sample_id, sample_id == "A13-A", "A13-A-old"), 
         sample_id = replace(sample_id, sample_id == "A13-S", "A13-S-old"),
         sample_id = replace(sample_id, sample_id == "A14-A", "A14-A-new"),
         sample_id = replace(sample_id, sample_id == "A14-S", "A14-S-old"))

iso_sum_diff <- iso_sum_diff |>
  mutate(sample_id = replace(sample_id, sample_id == "A-18-A", "A18-A"),
         sample_id = replace(sample_id, sample_id == "A-18-S", "A18-S"))

iso_ocu_merge <- oculina_mod |>
  left_join(iso_sum_diff, by = "sample_id")

iso_ocu_merge <- iso_ocu_merge |>
  filter(!is.na(diff_13C))
```

PERMANOVA for N15 and C13

```{r}

braycurtis_iso <- vegdist(iso_ocu_merge[, c(8:16364)], method = "bray")

perm_13c <- adonis2(braycurtis_iso ~ diff_13C, data = iso_ocu_merge[, c(8:16364, 16402)], permutations = 999)

perm_13c

perm_15n <- adonis2(braycurtis_iso ~ diff_15N, data = iso_ocu_merge[, c(8:16364, 16401)], permutations = 999)

perm_15n
```

rfpermute to see which features are useful in determining isotope *difference 15N*

```{r}
library(rfPermute)

num_df_iso_n15 <- iso_ocu_merge[,c(8:16364, 16401)]
#rfp_iso_n15 <- rfPermute(diff_15N ~., data = num_df_iso_n15, na.action = na.omit, ntree = 500, num.rep = 100)

rfp_iso_n15

rfp_table_iso_n15 <- as.data.frame(importance(rfp_iso_n15))  # Convert to a data frame
rfp_table_iso_n15 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(rfp_iso_n15, var = "Feature")
print(rfp_iso_n15)  # Display in console

#significant_features <- rfp_table %>% filter(B.pval < 0.05 & NB.pval < 0.05)  # Adjust p-value threshold as needed

#print(significant_features)

```

```{r}
rfp_table_iso_n15 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(rfp_table_iso_n15, var = "Feature")

```

```{r}
sig_feat_n15 <- rfp_table_iso_n15 %>% filter(`%IncMSE.pval` < 0.05) 
write.csv(sig_feat_n15, file = "sig_feat_diff_n15_rfpermute.csv")
sig_feat_n15 <- read.csv("sig_feat_diff_n15_rfpermute.csv")

sig_rows_n15 <- sig_feat_n15$Feature

num_df_sig_n15 <- data.matrix(num_df_final |>
  select(all_of(sig_rows_n15)))

log2FC_n15 <- sapply(sig_rows_n15, function(met){
  
  B_vals  <- (num_df_sig_n15[ocu_final$bleaching == "B", met])
  NB_vals <- (num_df_sig_n15[ocu_final$bleaching == "NB", met])

  mean_B  <- mean(B_vals,  na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_NB <- mean(NB_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

  log2(mean_B / mean_NB)
})

log2FC_n15_df <- data.frame(
  metabolite = sig_feat_n15,
  log2FC = log2FC_n15
)



```

```{r}

```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10}
library(ggpattern)

sig_feat_n15_joined <- log2FC_n15_df |>
  inner_join(feats_with_classes, join_by(metabolite.Feature == metabolite)) |>
  select(metabolite.Feature, 
         `metabolite.X.IncMSE`, 
         compound_class, 
         origin, 
         npc_number_superclass,
         log2FC) |>
     mutate(Sign = if_else(log2FC > 0, "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"))

sig_feat_n15_plot <- sig_feat_n15_joined |>
  arrange(desc(metabolite.X.IncMSE)) |>
  slice_head(n = 50)

ggplot(sig_feat_n15_plot, 
       aes(x = reorder(metabolite.Feature, `metabolite.X.IncMSE`), 
           y = `metabolite.X.IncMSE`,
           fill = compound_class,
           pattern = Sign
           )) +
  
  geom_col_pattern(
  pattern_density = 0.2,
  pattern_spacing = 0.03
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#C969A1FF", "#CE4441FF", "#EE8577FF", "#EB7926FF", "#FFBB44FF", "#859B6CFF", "#62929AFF", "#004F63FF", "#122451FF")
) +
  
  coord_flip() +  # Flip for better readability
  labs(title = "Variable Importance after rfPermute for n15 difference regression",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Mean Increase MSE") +
  theme_minimal()

```

scatter plot: metabolite diversity vs (H-S) 15n

```{r}
iso_ocu_div <- iso_ocu_merge |>
  full_join(ocu_fin_div[,c(9, 13, 22:24)], join_by("sample_id" == "id"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(iso_ocu_div, aes(x = Richness, y= diff_13C, color = depth_sa.x))+
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(aes(group = 1), method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") 

ggplot(iso_ocu_div, aes(x = Entropy, y= diff_13C, color = depth_sa.x))+
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(aes(group = 1), method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") 

```
